config.scope: Saved-score CPU analysis only. No model inference, API judging, reference generation, SFT or new behavioural evaluation. All fractions are reported; no winning fraction is selected. Raw projection is a proxy, not the paper's reference-subtracted metric.
config.random_control: Uniform without-replacement sample of k rows from the entire eligible pool. Overlap with either tail is allowed. The first pre-seeded draw supplies candidate IDs; 1000 draws describe subset-sampling variation, not behavioural uncertainty.
config.tie_policy: Sort by score then SHA-256(seed, row ID). Exact boundary ties are recorded. Near-zero or near-100 text ranks are not interpreted as calibrated differences.

projection_kind: raw response-token projection; no reference subtraction
